findings.description: Enumerated all 188 records of the pinned ASU Search API (dept_ids=1663, total_results=188, single page). 137 match required people; the other 51 are University Staff or a graduate assistant (advising, finance, HR, IT, project management) with no faculty rank; no omitted professor found.

Supporting page faculty.engineering.asu.edu/directory/ecee/rank was captured but renders client-side; its captured bytes contain only navigation, no faculty list. Decisions rely on the structured API fields.

ASU "Courtesy Affiliate" is a generic university affiliation status, not a courtesy professorial appointment. Courtesy Affiliates without a rank or employee class are excluded as affiliate (or emeritus/research where their titles say so).
